description.value: A simple recreation site strung along the Chilliwack River several kilometres past Thurston Meadows on Chilliwack Lake Road, with riverside and forested pitches each offering a picnic table and firepit; pack-in/pack-out with no garbage service, open April through October.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record is for 'Riverside Campground' but the website belongs to Camp Chilliwack Valley / Thurston Meadows, which manages Riverside as a separate recreation site 'several kilometers past Thurston Meadows.' The OSM tag group_only=yes is confirmed by the website, which describes Riverside as a group site made available after the Thurston Meadows Group Site was damaged by fall 2025 weather events, bookable by phone only. The FAQ confirms no wifi, no garbage pickup (pack-in/pack-out), and a wilderness setting outside cellular range. Phone and email match between OSM and the website. No amenity details specific to Riverside are provided beyond the group booking widget.
concerns: Group-only site per OSM tag and website — individual touring cyclists likely cannot book
Website URL is for Thurston Meadows, not Riverside specifically; Riverside is described as a separate site several km further along the road
OSM has no address; the website address (53425 Chilliwack Lake Road, Rosedale, BC) is for Thurston Meadows, not Riverside
Riverside's current group-site role may be temporary, contingent on Thurston Meadows group site remaining closed
Wilderness area with no cellular coverage and no garbage service (pack-in/pack-out)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: OSM tags and website confirm this is a group-only campsite (group_only=yes, phone-only booking), which severely limits usefulness for individual touring cyclists. Additionally, Riverside appears to be operating in a temporary capacity as a replacement for the weather-damaged Thurston Meadows group site, so its long-term availability is uncertain.
